_comment: Backtest routing: every study -> its automated backtest path. class TRIGGER with longSg/shortSg set is capture-ready (harness capture). TRIGGER with slots TBD needs a subgraph audit first. Classes: TRIGGER (discrete signals), ORDER (submits own orders; use built-in replay via SignalExecutor or its own logic), TOOL (backtest plumbing), DISPLAY (levels/lines/stats; not tradeable), UTIL (tape/DOM/nav/diagnostics; not backtestable), BLOCKED (no source). Subgraph indices are 0-based SCSubgraphRef slots.

SignalExecutor pairing: Live mode (Input 62=0) + closed-bar gate — in confirm mode TA posts bar k markers to SG[k-1] only when bar k+1 calculates, so the latest-bar executor reads 0 and misses entries. v9.3 P1s verified in source: inputs contiguous 0-89, strict-gate quorum + flip guard + calibrated Hurst all implemented.
